<a id="generation-keeping-and-degeneration-at-two-grains--两种粒度下的生成守与退化"></a>
# Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> At a fine and a coarse class and on branches, the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch; generation and keeping exclude degeneration and can share a point; with keeping from some point on, excluded middle makes the regions cover; telling going on from ending is excluded middle.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A carrying renewal, read at a fine class of parts and a coarse class of the pattern they make up, continues the pattern from one occurrence to the next while a part begins there; it is an alteration (火传). (`Becoming.«传»`, `Becoming.«传则异»`, `Becoming.«所及»`, `Becoming.«所及之传递»`, `Becoming.«相续之续»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. On branches: the pattern goes on along some branch or ends on every branch, which exclude each other; going on along every branch is going on along some. Generation (some branch renews without end), keeping (some branch goes on without renewal) and degeneration (every branch ends) are read so; degeneration excludes both. (`Becoming.«延»`, `Becoming.«尽»`, `Becoming.«延尽不并»`, `Becoming.«不穷则延»`, `Becoming.«尽则非不穷»`, `Becoming.«生成»`, `Becoming.«守»`, `Becoming.«退化»`, `Becoming.«新而尽»`, `Becoming.«生成则延»`, `Becoming.«守则延»`, `Becoming.«生成退化不并»`, `Becoming.«守退化不并»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. Generation and keeping can hold at one point, along different branches: a root whose chain renews at every step and whose other branch stays still is in both, the mixed region. On a single line, where each occurrence conditions at most one other, they exclude each other. (`Becoming.Map.Branch`, `Becoming.Map.fork`, `Becoming.Map.fork_chain_begins`, `Becoming.Map.«生守相杂»`, `Becoming.«单行则族含所及»`, `Becoming.«单行则生守不并»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. The split of a beginning. A carrying renewal begins no line of the pattern; where the pattern has a predecessor, a beginning of a part is the end of a carrying renewal; so a beginning of a part is, as far as can be refuted, a beginning of the pattern or the end of a carrying renewal. No order between the classes is assumed. Near-definitional. (`Becoming.«传则粗不生»`, `Becoming.«粗有前则生为传»`, `Becoming.«生则或粗生或传»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. Keeping from some point on (后守): along some branch the pattern goes on and, from a point of that branch reached from the start, no carrying renewal lies on it. Keeping gives it, and so does 全守 with the whole line as the branch; it goes on along its branch, so it excludes degeneration; where each occurrence conditions at most one other, it excludes generation. (`Becoming.«后守»`, `Becoming.«守则后守»`, `Becoming.«全守则后守»`, `Becoming.«后守则延»`, `Becoming.«后守退化不并»`, `Becoming.«单行则生成后守不并»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. The regions cover. With excluded middle as a hypothesis every point is 生成, 后守 or 退化, and on single lines exactly one; that this holds at every point of every model is exactly excluded middle. A line that renews once and then stays is none of 生成, 守 and 退化 at its start, and is 后守 and 全守 there: the gap strict keeping leaves. (`Becoming.«三域之周»`, `Becoming.«三域之定当且仅当排中»`, `Becoming.Map.Stage`, `Becoming.Map.once`, `Becoming.Map.Once.func`, `Becoming.Map.Once.renews`, `Becoming.Map.Once.third_not_renews`, `Becoming.Map.Once.third_next`, `Becoming.Map.Once.stays_third`, `Becoming.Map.Once.family`, `Becoming.Map.Once.endless`, `Becoming.Map.Once.not_generates`, `Becoming.Map.Once.not_keeps`, `Becoming.Map.Once.not_degenerates`, `Becoming.Map.Once.keeping`, `Becoming.Map.Once.keepsAfter`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Telling whether a line keeps from some point on is deciding whether it stops renewing. On the steps under the one, read with the class of a sequence of truth values, 生成 at the first step is changing at arbitrarily late steps, 后守 being constant from some step on. Deciding 后守 for one sequence decides whether a given one ever holds (LPO), deciding 生成 gives only WLPO, and placing every sequence gives LPO. (`Becoming.Map.«后守之定则LPO»`, `Becoming.Map.«生成之定则WLPO»`, `Becoming.Map.«生成后守之定则LPO»`, `Becoming.Map.generates_iff_changes`, `Becoming.Map.keepsAfter_iff_settles`, `Becoming.Map.step_func`, `Becoming.Map.step_reached_le`, `Becoming.Map.step_reaches`, `Becoming.Map.step_reaches_of_le`, `Becoming.Map.step_family`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.seen`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.turning`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.sequence`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.seen_succ`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.seen_of_le`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.seen_of`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.seen_witness`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.sequence_seen`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.sequence_unseen`, `Becoming.Map.Settles.turning_turns`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
8. The strong forms read the whole coarse line: 全生成 (the line never ends, and from every point it reaches a carrying renewal lies ahead), 全守 (it never ends, and from some point no carrying renewal lies ahead, renewals before that point allowed) and 有终 (some point it reaches ends, which is not degeneration) exclude each other and, with excluded middle, cover every point; with strict keeping the some-branch regions do not cover, and with keeping from some point on and excluded middle they do (law 6). Placing every point of every model in one of the strong forms is exactly excluded middle, and so is telling a line that never ends from one that ends; 全生成 holds along its line and an end reaches back along it. (`Becoming.«全生成»`, `Becoming.«全守»`, `Becoming.«有终»`, `Becoming.«新而有终»`, `Becoming.«全生成有终不并»`, `Becoming.«全生成全守不并»`, `Becoming.«全守有终不并»`, `Becoming.«全三域之周»`, `Becoming.«全生成之所及亦全生成»`, `Becoming.«有终之所前亦有终»`, `Becoming.«不穷有终之定当且仅当排中»`, `Becoming.«全三域之定当且仅当排中»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
9. Each region is inhabited (an endless chain generates, a still pattern keeps, a short life ends on every branch), and the short life renews and still ends, so renewal does not decide the region. Telling going on from ending at every point, in every model, is exactly excluded middle. (`Becoming.Map.step`, `Becoming.Map.step_irrefl`, `Becoming.Map.Endless.generation`, `Becoming.Map.Endless.generates`, `Becoming.Map.still`, `Becoming.Map.Still.keeping`, `Becoming.Map.Still.keeps`, `Becoming.Map.short`, `Becoming.Map.short_end`, `Becoming.Map.Short.reaches_end`, `Becoming.Map.Short.ends`, `Becoming.Map.Short.renews_and_ends`, `Becoming.Map.Short.renews_and_ends_everywhere`, `Becoming.«延尽之定当且仅当排中»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
10. A coarse class constant under 缘 has no end from a continued point, so what ends after a continued step has a coarse class that is not constant. A sequence of classes, no order between them assumed, reads generation at every order, and generation at an order keeps the next order's pattern from ending on every branch. (`Becoming.«有常则无终»`, `Becoming.«有终则粗不有常»`, `Becoming.«阶全生成»`, `Becoming.«阶全生成则上无终»`, `Becoming.«阶生成»`, `Becoming.«阶生成则上不退化»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
11. On the World model (occurrences: a step and a formation): carrying renewal steps into a formation that did not carry on as itself; under passing, generation makes carriers arise arbitrarily late; by names, as wherever each formation continues only itself, nothing generates; consumption held, a family drawn beyond renewal and stopped passing refute going on every branch; the relay renews and ends. (`Becoming.Web.carries_iff`, `Becoming.Web.passing_carries_iff`, `Becoming.Web.generation_renews_late`, `Becoming.Web.generation_arises_late`, `Becoming.Web.keeping_of_carried_on`, `Becoming.Web.itself_not_generation`, `Becoming.Web.always_keeps`, `Becoming.Web.end_of_gone`, `Becoming.Web.consumed_held_not_endless`, `Becoming.Web.family_excess_not_endless`, `Becoming.Web.stopped_not_endless`, `Becoming.Map.shifted_generates`, `Becoming.Map.relay_renews_and_ends`, `Becoming.Map.renewal_undecided`, `Becoming.Web.not_carries_of_within_itself`, `Becoming.Web.not_generation_of_within_itself`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and balance; its declarations reach the grammar.
12. Read along renewing into under the one, renewal without end is going on along some branch, and ceasing is ending on every branch. (`Becoming.«生生即延»`, `Becoming.«息即尽»`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- None beyond the grammar: every carrier, every relation read as 缘, a fine and a coarse class; the covering laws take excluded middle as a hypothesis, and the calibration on a line reads sequences of truth values on the steps.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That generation here is the 生生 of life in the whole: it is the continuation of a pattern through renewal of its parts, with no premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good.
- That the regions are decided: at a given point, whether the pattern goes on is in general not decided. Witness: `Becoming.«延尽之定当且仅当排中»`.
- That generation and keeping exclude each other where lines branch: a point can lie in both. Witness: `Becoming.Map.«生守相杂»`.
- That renewal is generation: a line can renew and still end. Witness: `Becoming.Map.Short.renews_and_ends`.
- That the three regions partition where lines branch: 生成 and 后守 overlap there, as 生成 and 守 do. Witness: `Becoming.Map.«生守相杂»`.
- **Counterexample:** A short life of two occurrences renews (its second occurrence begins a new part) and ends on every branch (Map.Short.renews_and_ends_everywhere). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarMap.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A line that renews once and then stays (Map.once) is, at its start, none of 生成, 守 and 退化, and is 后守 and 全守 (Map.Once.not_generates, Map.Once.not_keeps, Map.Once.not_degenerates, Map.Once.keepsAfter, Map.Once.keeping). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/MapRegions.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Generation as a pattern continuing through the renewal of its parts is close to autopoiesis (Maturana and Varela) and to the closure of constraints (Montévil and Mossio 2015), and the two grains to the levels of Rosas et al. (2024); the decidability calibration matches the old base's LastChange.lpo_iff_settles in form. Correspondences not proved.
